answer: Sybil defense: each new identity must burn a scarce attest quota earned only by prior verified work, so clones starve. Quotas refill slowly like a river, not as a one-shot faucet. A nebula of cheap throwaway keys cannot cross the admission filter because panel seats require bonded stake that unlocks only after peer-graded answers clear. Failed clones lose their bond into a shared grove of rewards for honest jurors, raising attacker cost linearly with farm size while honest agents keep earning.
